row: Hold Fast To Dreams Animal Sanctuary & Rescue ODV

Welcome to our Italian Farm!🐴🐔🐶 We are an animal rescue, sanctuary, and horse farm here in the countryside of Italy. We started out as two cousins traveling around Europe in a caravan saving all the animals we could safely fit in our van. We’ve re-homed over 200 rescue dogs and now that we have our land to call home, we are a forever home to many of our horses, dogs, cats, goats, donkeys, birds and whatever other wonderful creatures join us along the way. We also open our doors to many van-lifers as a place for them to come spend some time with the animals whether it’s just a stop over on their travels or a place they’d like to spend some time volunteering with the animals and our team. 😅🚐🐶🐱🐰🐴✨
